critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown to 846 lines; consider splitting auth/matches/rules/awards into routers for maintainability.
optional_user dependency is a good pattern; ensure it never raises when cookie is absent (verified: returns None and endpoints handle it).
Register endpoint uses env INVITE_CODE with default '267710' — good; consider rate-limiting register attempts to prevent invite-code brute-force.
Rules list computes usage_count via aggregation on every GET /api/rules — fine for current scale but could be denormalized if the rule library grows.
Console shows expected 401 on GET /api/auth/me for guests; verify Login.jsx does not treat that as an error toast (no error toast observed).
